verdict.rationale: Restate's docs include an Admin API reference with per-endpoint pages, such as the cluster state endpoint and an endpoint that returns an OpenAPI 3.1 spec for each service. This is a structured API reference, but nothing shows it is interactive or offers runnable examples, and probes found no docs-level OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console, runnable examples in the reference, a published docs-level OpenAPI spec, and any hands-on corroboration.
